newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch Sept manufacturing sales rise 4 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Sept manufacturing sales rise 4 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Dutch September manufacturing sales were some four percent higher than in the same month of 1995, the Central Bureau of Statistics said.

The CBS manufacturing sales figures refer to the guilder value of manufacturers' sales and are usually published one to two weeks before manufacturing production figures which show the rise or fall in volume terms.
Domestic sales rose by seven percent in September, while exports increased by one percent, the CBS said.

The CBS said turnover increased most in the petroleum industry (+29 pct) and the leather and shoe industry (+22 pct), while turnover in the paper industry decreased by 11 percent and clothing industry by seven percent.
